<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class DocumentService {
    private PDO $db;
    private const PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    private const MAX_RESULTS = 10000;
    private const MAX_PAGE = 200;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->db = new PDO(
            'mysql:host=' . getenv('DB_HOST') . ';dbname=' . getenv('DB_NAME') . ';charset=utf8mb4',
            getenv('DB_USER'),
            getenv('DB_PASS'),
            [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
            ]
        );
    }

    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/', $token)) {
            return null;
        }
        $hash = hash('sha256', $token);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT user_id, org_id, role FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = :hash AND expires_at > NOW()'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':hash' => $hash]);
        return $stmt->fetch() ?: null;
    }

    public function calculateOffset(int $page, int $userDocCount): int {
        // Hard cap on page number to prevent integer overflow on any platform
        if ($page < 1) {
            $page = 1;
        }
        if ($page > self::MAX_PAGE) {
            $page = self::MAX_PAGE;
        }
        $maxPage = (int)ceil($userDocCount / self::PAGE_SIZE);
        if ($page > $maxPage && $maxPage > 0) {
            $page = $maxPage;
        }
        // Safe: MAX_PAGE(200) * PAGE_SIZE(50) = 10000, well within 32-bit int range
        $offset = ($page - 1) * self::PAGE_SIZE;
        // Defense in depth: ensure offset is never negative
        if ($offset < 0 || $offset > self::MAX_RESULTS) {
            $offset = 0;
        }
        return $offset;
    }

    public function getSharedDocuments(int $orgId, int $page, int $requestingUserId): array {
        // Get total count of shared docs in org for pagination bounds
        $countStmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM documents WHERE org_id = :org_id AND (owner_id = :uid OR shared = 1)'
        );
        $countStmt->execute([':org_id' => $orgId, ':uid' => $requestingUserId]);
        $totalCount = (int)$countStmt->fetch()['cnt'];

        $offset = $this->calculateOffset($page, $totalCount);

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, title, owner_id, created_at FROM documents WHERE org_id = :org_id AND (owner_id = :uid OR shared = 1) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset'
        );
        $stmt->bindValue(':org_id', $orgId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':uid', $requestingUserId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', self::PAGE_SIZE, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    public function getPrivateDocuments(int $userId, int $page, int $filterOrgId): array {
        // Get user's private document count
        $countStmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM documents WHERE owner_id = :uid AND shared = 0 AND org_id = :org_id'
        );
        $countStmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':org_id' => $filterOrgId]);
        $totalCount = (int)$countStmt->fetch()['cnt'];

        $offset = $this->calculateOffset($page, $totalCount);

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, title, content_preview, created_at FROM documents WHERE owner_id = :uid AND shared = 0 AND org_id = :org_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset'
        );
        $stmt->bindValue(':uid', $userId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':org_id', $filterOrgId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', self::PAGE_SIZE, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    public function searchDocuments(int $orgId, int $userId, string $query, int $page): array {
        $safeQuery = '%' . addcslashes($query, '%_\\') . '%';
        
        // Count matching documents for pagination
        $countStmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM documents WHERE org_id = :org_id AND (owner_id = :uid OR shared = 1) AND title LIKE :query'
        );
        $countStmt->execute([':org_id' => $orgId, ':uid' => $userId, ':query' => $safeQuery]);
        $totalCount = (int)$countStmt->fetch()['cnt'];

        $offset = $this->calculateOffset($page, $totalCount);

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, title, owner_id, created_at FROM documents WHERE org_id = :org_id AND (owner_id = :uid OR shared = 1) AND title LIKE :query ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset'
        );
        $stmt->bindValue(':org_id', $orgId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':uid', $userId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':query', $safeQuery, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', self::PAGE_SIZE, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', $offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    public function getDocumentById(int $docId, int $userId, int $orgId): ?array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, title, content, owner_id, shared, org_id, created_at FROM documents WHERE id = :id'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $docId]);
        $doc = $stmt->fetch();
        if (!$doc) {
            return null;
        }
        // Authorization: user must own the doc OR doc must be shared within same org
        if ((int)$doc['owner_id'] === $userId) {
            return $doc;
        }
        if ((int)$doc['shared'] === 1 && (int)$doc['org_id'] === $orgId) {
            return $doc;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

class RequestHandler {
    private DocumentService $service;

    public function __construct(DocumentService $service) {
        $this->service = $service;
    }

    public function handle(): void {
        header('Content-Type: application/json');

        $token = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '';
        $token = preg_replace('/^Bearer\s+/', '', $token);

        $session = $this->service->validateToken($token);
        if ($session === null) {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'unauthorized']);
            return;
        }

        $userId = (int)$session['user_id'];
        $orgId = (int)$session['org_id'];
        $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);
        $page = isset($_GET['page']) ? (int)$_GET['page'] : 1;

        try {
            switch ($path) {
                case '/api/documents/shared':
                    $result = $this->service->getSharedDocuments($orgId, $page, $userId);
                    break;
                case '/api/documents/private':
                    $result = $this->service->getPrivateDocuments($userId, $page, $orgId);
                    break;
                case '/api/documents/search':
                    $query = $_GET['q'] ?? '';
                    if (strlen($query) > 200 || strlen($query) < 1) {
                        http_response_code(400);
                        echo json_encode(['error' => 'invalid_query']);
                        return;
                    }
                    $result = $this->service->searchDocuments($orgId, $userId, $query, $page);
                    break;
                case '/api/documents/view':
                    $docId = isset($_GET['id']) ? (int)$_GET['id'] : 0;
                    if ($docId <= 0) {
                        http_response_code(400);
                        echo json_encode(['error' => 'invalid_id']);
                        return;
                    }
                    $result = $this->service->getDocumentById($docId, $userId, $orgId);
                    if ($result === null) {
                        http_response_code(404);
                        echo json_encode(['error' => 'not_found']);
                        return;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    http_response_code(404);
                    echo json_encode(['error' => 'not_found']);
                    return;
            }
            echo json_encode(['data' => $result]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            http_response_code(500);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'internal_error']);
        }
    }
}

$handler = new RequestHandler(new DocumentService());
$handler->handle();
